title: Investing in Austin, New City Truck
summary:
*   **Sanitary Sewer Funding Boost:** $25,000 was transferred from the water and light fund to improve the city's sanitary sewer system, highlighting a focus on public health infrastructure.
*   **Modernizing City Services:** The Sanitary Department acquired a new "automobile truck" for $3,600 from Tiffin Wagon Co. (via Walter Tips Co.) after an expert committee evaluated multiple bids.
*   **City Funds Custodian Chosen:** Chester Thrasher was selected as the City Treasurer for the next two years, offering the highest interest rate on daily city fund balances, contingent on a $100,000 bond.
*   **Riverside Drive Water Line:** A private citizen was granted permission to install a four-inch water pipe across Riverside Drive for land irrigation, under the supervision of the City Engineer.
